limitations: Not a classification of conjugacy classes or centralizer algebra structures.
Coefficient ring is finite, commutative and local, with nonprincipal maximal ideal satisfying m^2=0.
Asymptotic fixes residue-field size while embedding dimension grows.
An equivalent historical formula under broader conjugacy and commuting-scheme terminology remains a priority risk.
scientific_integrity: Exact full-matrix centralizer-size multiplicities and commuting probability for all finite commutative local rings with nonzero square-zero maximal ideal of dimension d>=2 over the residue field. Includes mixed characteristic, no splitting hypothesis. Proof is self-contained. Exhaustive computations check q=2,d=2 and both length-two q=2 boundary rings. No independent validation has been performed.
title: Four centralizer strata and a saturation law over square-zero local rings
